# Parse the old songs list into a set of (title, artists) tuples
old_songs = set()
for line in old_songs_file['content'].splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
        if ' by ' in line:
            title, artists_str = line.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.add((title.strip().lower(), tuple(a.lower() for a in artists)))
print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
print(old_songs)
